summary: China Coast Guard vessel 5306 activated its water cannon while shadowing BRP Cabra about nine nautical miles north of Second Thomas Shoal and repeatedly obstructed the PCG's evacuation of a sick serviceman from the BRP Sierra Madre, insisting on a transfer point farther away and delaying it by nearly ten hours.
reasoning: Water cannon and blocking of a medical evacuation; coercive.

sources.title: China Coast Guard disrupts medical evacuation at Ayungin Shoal
sources.excerpt: At around 7:30 a.m., as BRP Cabra approached within nine nautical miles north of Ayungin Shoal, CCG vessel 5306 activated its water cannon while shadowing the Philippine ship.
